brief: Records from an input device and hands back the recording as an ordinary stzSound.
detail: RecordFor records for a number of seconds in one call; StartRecording, Collect and StopRecording let you drive it and watch the level as it goes. Collect is not optional: the device fills a ring of about 250 ms and, if nobody drains it, the newest frames are dropped and counted as overruns, never written over unread audio. A machine with no input or no device library is a supported configuration and IsAvailable answers 0. For this reference the microphone was never opened and no device was queried, so the example uses only what touches none: the settings, the counters at rest and the refusals. Nothing was recorded or heard (UNPERCEIVED).
